fullPassage: Jake's own flying dream began at a village festival. He was four years old. His uncle, a tall silent pilot, had bought him a red party balloon from a charity stall, and tied it to the top button of Jake's shirt. The balloon seemed to have a mind of its own. It was filled with helium, a gas four times lighter than air, though Jake did not understand this at the time. It pulled mysteriously at his button. "Maybe you will fly," Jake's uncle remarked. He led his nephew up a grassy bank so they could look over the whole festival. Below Jake stretched the little tents and the stalls. Above him bobbed the big red balloon, shiny and beautiful. It kept pulling him towards the sky, and he began to feel unsteady on his feet. Then his uncle let go of his hand, and Jake's dream began.

det.analysis: 본문 'helium, a gas four times lighter than air'에서 헬륨은 '공기보다 네 배 가벼운(four times lighter than air)' 기체로 묘사돼요. 5단어: four, times, lighter, than, air.
det.tip: a gas ___ → four times lighter than air.

questions.passage: It was filled with helium, a gas four times lighter than air, though Jake did not understand this at the time. It pulled __________ (mysterious) at his button.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

det.korean: 형용사 mysterious → 부사 mysteriously: 동사 pulled를 꾸미는 부사 자리
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'It pulled __________ at his button'에서 동사 pulled를 꾸미는 부사 자리예요. 형용사 mysterious(신비로운)를 부사 mysteriously(신비롭게)로 바꿔 'pulled mysteriously(신비롭게 끌어당겼다)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: 동사를 꾸미는 부사 자리. mysterious(형용사) → mysteriously(부사).

questions.passage: Jake's own flying dream began at a village festival. He was four years old. His uncle, a tall silent pilot, had bought him a red party balloon from a charity stall, and tied it to the top button of Jake's shirt. The balloon seemed to have a mind of its own. It was filled with helium, a gas four times lighter than air, though Jake did not understand this at the time. It pulled mysteriously at his button. "Maybe you will fly," Jake's uncle remarked. He led his nephew up a grassy bank so they could look over the whole festival. Below Jake stretched the little tents and the stalls. Above him bobbed the big red balloon, shiny and beautiful. It kept pulling him towards the sky, and he began to feel unsteady on his feet. Then his uncle let go of his hand, and Jake's dream began.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 풍선을 통해 비행의 꿈을 품게 된 소년의 경험이 주제
det.analysis:
✅ ① 네 살 Jake가 축제에서 헬륨 풍선에 끌려 올라가는 느낌을 받으며 비행의 꿈을 처음 품게 된 경험을 다루므로 주제로 적절해요. ←정답

❌ ② 헬륨의 산업적 활용은 다루지 않았어요.

❌ ③ 축제 볼거리 소개가 핵심이 아니에요.

❌ ④ 조종사 훈련 과정은 본문에 없어요.
det.tip: flying dream began + balloon pulling towards the sky → 비행의 꿈

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 풍선 경험을 통해 비행의 꿈을 처음 갖게 되었다는 것이 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 꿈을 물려받았다는 내용이 아니에요.

❌ ② 풍선의 위험성을 경고하는 글이 아니에요.

❌ ③ 축제가 유익하지 않다는 내용은 없어요.

✅ ④ 어린 Jake가 헬륨 풍선에 끌려 올라가는 경험으로 비행의 꿈을 처음 갖게 되었다는 글의 핵심이라 요지로 적절해요. ←정답

questions.stem:
위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'그 풍선은 자기만의 생각을 가진 것 같았다'

[조건]
(1) a, balloon, have, its, mind, of, own, seemed, the, to 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 그 풍선은 자기만의 생각을 가진 것 같았다
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- The balloon(주어): 그 풍선은
- seemed to have(seem + to부정사): 가진 것 같았다
- a mind of its own(목적어): 자기만의 생각
seem은 뒤에 to부정사를 취해 'seemed to have(가진 것 같았다)'가 되고, a mind of its own은 '자기만의 생각'이라는 관용 표현이에요. 10단어로 배열합니다.
det.tip: seem + to부정사. seemed to have a mind of its own. 10단어.
